mentions.name: storica.club
mentions.description: This language learning platform teaches new languages through actual content that adults can enjoy, taking an adult-oriented approach to language learning.
mentions.problem: Typical language learning approaches rely on content that adults cannot enjoy, so this project experiments with an adult way to learn through actual content.
mentions.audience: Adults who want to learn a new language through content they can enjoy
mentions.source_excerpt: Building storica.club, experimenting the adult way to learn a new language, through actual content that an adult can enjoy.
